GIT: story/dev work opens its own git worktree off main_debug BEFORE editing files — and a fresh chat resuming an in-flight story RE-ENTERS that existing worktree (git worktree list), never a second one or the shared checkout; commit freely inside it (explicit paths, never git add -A). Landing on main_debug needs sign-off from Daniel or /sudo-update-sprint-memory; main is owner-only (worktree-per-story + git-policy).'; $rm = Join-Path $d 'docs/repo-map.md'; if (Test-Path $rm) { Write-Output ''; Write-Output '# Repo map (navigation index):'; Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 $rm }"
